cohort: The study participants included 958 mothers who delivered a live baby during a 4-week study period across 9 hospitals in Oman.
finding: The developed 10-item Arabic Childbirth Care Satisfaction Survey (CCSS) tool demonstrated good face and content validity, good internal reliability, construct validity, and discriminant validity.
mod_finding: Mothers who experienced vaginal delivery reported higher satisfaction compared to those who underwent caesarean section.
